name: UNDAWN: Shackles Of Eternity
source:
UNDAWN: Shackles Of Eternity is a dark fantasy adult visual novel.
This is a story set in a world where light and shadow have long since merged, and truth depends only on who holds the greater power.  There are no righteous sides here, no heroes in shining armor. Even the purest intentions can turn into disaster, and the most obvious choice may open the door to something far worse.

At the center of it - Rhiannon. Her past is veiled in shadow, and her present is a journey through a world where faith is twisted and hope comes at too high a price. She is beautiful yet cold, intelligent yet distant — and it is through her eyes that the story unfolds. Rhiannon is no savior, but neither is she a monster; she is someone who has lived in the dark for too long to still believe in simple truths.

[From [url=https://subscribestar.adult/Kind_Nightmares]SubscribeStar[/url]]
translation:
《UNDAWN：永恒的枷锁》是一部黑暗奇幻成人视觉小说。
这是一个发生在光与影早已融合的世界里的故事，真相只取决于谁拥有更大的力量。这里没有正义的一方，没有披着闪亮盔甲的英雄。即使是最纯粹的意图也可能变成灾难，而最明显的选择可能会导致更糟糕的情况。

在它的中心——Rhiannon。她的过去笼罩在阴影之中，而她的现在则是一段穿越世界的旅程，在这个世界中，信仰被扭曲，希望的代价太高。她美丽却冷漠，聪明又疏远——故事就是通过她的眼睛展开的。莱安农不是救世主，但她也不是怪物。她是一个生活在黑暗中太久而仍然相信简单真理的人。
